declarations.name: actualDwellSupport_prod_le
declarations.signature:
theorem actualDwellSupport_prod_le {D : ℝ} (input : List ℕ) (hne : input ≠ [])
    (hpositive : ∀ p ∈ input, 0 < p) (hfull : actualDwellSupport D input) :
    (input.prod : ℝ) ≤ D

declarations.name: actualRoughPrimeVector_length_le
declarations.signature:
theorem actualRoughPrimeVector_length_le {x ρ λ₀ : ℝ}
    (hx : 1 < x) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hλ : λ₀ ≤ 5 / 8)
    (input : List ℕ) (hne : input ≠ [])
    (hpositive : ∀ p ∈ input, 0 < p)
    (hrough : ∀ p ∈ input, x ^ ρ ≤ (p : ℝ))
    (hfull : actualDwellSupport (x ^ λ₀) input) :
    input.length ≤ actualRoughVectorRankBound ρ

declarations.name: mapped_upper_prod_le_inflation
declarations.signature:
private theorem mapped_upper_prod_le_inflation {α : Type*} (x τ : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x)
    (actual upper : α → ℕ) (input : List α)
    (hsize : ∀ i ∈ input, (upper i : ℝ) ≤ x ^ τ * (actual i : ℝ)) :
    (input.map (fun i => (upper i : ℝ))).prod ≤
      (x ^ τ) ^ input.length * (input.map (fun i => (actual i : ℝ))).prod

declarations.name: actualDwellSupport_upper_inflation
declarations.signature:
theorem actualDwellSupport_upper_inflation {α : Type*} {x τ λ₀ λ₁ : ℝ} {R : ℕ}
    (hx : 1 < x) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (actual upper : α → ℕ) (input : List α)
    (hlen : input.length ≤ R)
    (hsize : ∀ i ∈ input, (upper i : ℝ) ≤ x ^ τ * (actual i : ℝ))
    (hfull : actualDwellSupport (x ^ λ₀) (input.map actual))
    (hbudget : λ₀ + τ * (R + 1) ≤ λ₁) :
    actualDwellSupport (x ^ λ₁) (input.map upper)

declarations.name: actualExtendedThirdSelectedPair_upperSupport
declarations.signature:
theorem actualExtendedThirdSelectedPair_upperSupport
    {α : Type*} {e δ ρ τ x : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384) (hδ : δ ≤ e / 32)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ)
    (hwidth : τ * (actualRoughVectorRankBound ρ + 1) ≤ e / 2)
    (hmesh : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m ≤ e / 32)
    (hfull : actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi m j 0 ≤ VariableEnvelope.mu - 4 * e)
    {t : Fin 3 → ℝ} (ht : t ∈ actualExtendedThirdPhysicalCell m j)
    (yz : Bool) (hk : actualExtendedThirdLeastWinningIndex e m j = if yz then 7 else 6)
    (hx : 1 < x) (actual upper : α → ℕ) (input : List α) (hne : input ≠ [])
    (hpositive : ∀ i ∈ input, 0 < actual i)
    (hrough : ∀ i ∈ input, x ^ ρ ≤ (actual i : ℝ))
    (hsize : ∀ i ∈ input, (upper i : ℝ) ≤ x ^ τ * (actual i : ℝ))
    (hsupport : actualDwellSupport (x ^ actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j)
      (input.map actual)) :
    actualDwellSupport (x ^ (actualExtendedThirdPairParameter e m j t yz - 2 * δ))
      (input.map upper)

mathematical_findings.detail: The explicit nonempty hypothesis permits snoc decomposition and the original final indexed square test. Positive natural last slot is at least one, hence p<=p^2. Its nonnegative original prefix product preserves this inequality. Original mapped/natural product casting gives input.prod<=D. No bound is asserted for an empty vector with arbitrary D.

Every original occurrence, including repeats, is at least x^rho. Nonnegative list product monotonicity gives (x^rho)^length<=original product<=x^lambda0<=x^(5/8). Positive base x>1 allows exponent cancellation, giving rho*length<=5/8. Since rho>0, division and Nat.le_floor_iff yield length<=floor((5/8)/rho). Neither primality nor Nodup is hidden in this purely numerical statement.

Induction over the original label list multiplies one x^tau per occurrence. Both lower product factors used by mul_le_mul are nonnegative because upper and actual values are natural, and the inflation factor is nonnegative for any real tau at positive x. Associative/commutative product rewriting yields exactly (x^tau)^length times original actual product.

The upper and actual map lists have identical lengths and their take/get operations refer to the same original index i. Prefix product inflation costs i copies of x^tau; monotone squaring of the current natural upper bound costs two more. The full term is therefore at most (x^tau)^(i+2) times the original actual indexed square term. The source hypothesis is precisely original full support, not support on a replacement remainder.

i<length<=R implies i+2<=R+1. Nonnegative tau preserves that inequality. Real.rpow_mul_natCast and Real.rpow_add identify the resulting bound with x^(tau*(i+2)+lambda0), and the explicit budget lambda0+tau*(R+1)<=lambda1 completes it. Natural casts and the real-floor ratio have matching directions.

The same previously chosen pair parameter at t supplies lambda+e<=theta and theta<5/8 on the same physical cell. Thus the actual original source level is <=5/8, and the rough length theorem supplies the uniform rank bound for input.map actual. Width cost<=e/2 and delta<=e/32 imply lambda+cost<=theta-2delta with positive spare e. This pays the original entire upper vector without asking for a remaining-square or assignment predicate.

signatures: List.prod_map_le_prod_map₀: nonnegative lower entries plus pointwise comparison imply mapped product comparison.
Real.rpow_mul takes a nonnegative base; Real.rpow_natCast converts the natural-length real exponent to a natural power.
Real.rpow_le_rpow_left_iff requires x>1 and cancels the fixed base from a non-strict inequality.
Nat.le_floor_iff takes a nonnegative real argument; the argument (5/8)/rho is nonnegative from rho>0.
pow_le_pow_left₀ takes nonnegative smaller base and its comparison, then a natural exponent.
List.forall_mem_map converts the exact mapped-value positivity and roughness statements back to original label membership.

Prime/Nodup or squarefreeness conditions remain separate when later coprimality or exact source-coefficient representations require them.
A concrete selected-pair remaining-vector dictionary and its endpoint pair square gate are still required for the complete three-factor box action.
